title: The Fruitbowl
description: Vanilla plus modpack with a little fun. Made for Multiplayer
body:
Vanilla plus modpack with a little extra fun, made for use on servers with lots of fun mods to explore with friends, Official modpack of the fruitbowl server

Features include
- Stunning visuals thanks to, tectonic, biomes o plenty and better end for terain generation, iris for shaders, distant horizons and dramatic skies for stunning views, and lots of gui mods to make the menus cleaner and better.
- fun exploration thanks to, immersive airplanes for balanced yet fun flying, adventure backpacks for a on the go upgradeable storage option, towns and taverns for lots of interesting structures to explore, wraith waystones for a fair teleportation system, and xaero's minimap for the best minimap system.
- multiplayer fun thanks to, simple voice chat for proximity chat, better days for a fun sleeping system, emotecraft for fun expresions, lootr so everyone has a chance to find loot, key for a chest locking system, and more.
- and of course lots optimization for a smooth experience

Known issues
- Trims - Trims currently do not work in jei, to view all trim recipes and effects view the better trims mod page [BetterTrims](https://modrinth.com/mod/bettertrims)

u can download the provided server version in the versions tab
                        
follow the fruitbowl TikTok page
